findings.title: Denial cache key omits identity type
findings.body: The denial key is built from namespace, `UserUID`, action, name, and parent folder, but not `IdentityType`. Anonymous and render identities can both use UID `0`, so a cached denial for an anonymous check can be reused for a render check of the same resource. Since render checks are otherwise granted read access, this incorrectly denies rendering until the denial entry expires. Include the identity type in the key.
